title: Se7en — Seven days of rain

hook.context: Filmning so'nggi sahnasida yosh detektiv Mills cho'l o'rtasida kelgan quti ichida nima borligini so'raydi. Oddiy savol, lekin kino tarixidagi eng dahshatli lahzalardan biriga aylangan.

reading: It rains almost every day in the unnamed city. Detective William Somerset is old, tired and only seven days away from retirement. He wishes he could live somewhere quiet, far from crime.
His new partner, David Mills, is young, ambitious and impatient. He has just moved to the city with his wife Tracy, and he believes he can change things.
Together they investigate a series of murders. Each crime is connected to one of the seven deadly sins: greed, pride, laziness and others.
Somerset goes to the library and reads old books to understand the killer. Mills thinks that is a waste of time. Later he wishes he had listened to the older detective.
Tracy feels lonely in the new city. She secretly tells Somerset about a problem in her life, and she wishes she could talk to her husband about it.
The killer, John Doe, is always one step ahead. He is patient, careful and completely calm.
In the end, the detectives don't win. Somerset says that the world is a fine place and worth fighting for, but he only agrees with the second part. If only things had ended differently.

grammar.title: wish / if only
explain: **wish + Past Simple** — hozirgi holatdan norozilik: He **wishes** he **lived** somewhere quiet (hozir u shovqinli shaharda). To be bilan: I wish I **were** taller.
**wish + could** — hozir qila olmaydigan narsa: She **wishes** she **could talk** to her husband.
**wish + Past Perfect** — o'tmishdagi afsus: Mills **wishes** he **had listened** to Somerset (lekin tinglamagan).
**If only** — wish bilan bir xil, lekin kuchliroq his: **If only** things **had ended** differently! Boshqa odamning odatidan shikoyat: I wish you **would** stop talking (wish + would).

exercises.q: Mills wishes he ___ to Somerset earlier.
I wish I ___ speak English fluently.
If only I ___ so much money last month!
exercises.why: O'tmishga afsus: if only + Past Perfect.

exercises.q: I wish it ___ raining. It's been raining for a week!
exercises.why: Bezovta qiluvchi holat o'zgarishi istagi: wish + would.

exercises.q: She wishes she ___ in a big city. She hates the noise.
If only you ___ me the truth yesterday.
